requirement_text: Experiment runner executes controlled A/B sessions with clean isolation per run
target_value: Both conditions execute identically except RTMX presence
notes: Foundation: everything depends on the runner

requirement_text: Token accounting extracts per-session counts with RTMX attribution
target_value: input/output/rtmx/planning/execution tokens extracted
notes: Decomposes total cost into RTMX vs other

requirement_text: Prompt identity enforced with SHA-256 verification and no RTMX references
target_value: Same prompt hash for both conditions
notes: Critical experimental control

requirement_text: Outcome verification runs test suite independently after each session
target_value: Pass/partial/fail/error classified from test results
notes: Prevents measuring failed attempts as successes

requirement_text: Statistical analysis computes significance tests and amortization curves
target_value: Mann-Whitney U test with 95% CI on token efficiency ratio
notes: Single-run comparisons are anecdotal

requirement_text: Scatter score counts intent-bearing files across repo directories
target_value: File count and directory depth computed from patterns
notes: Most fundamental entropy dimension

requirement_text: Staleness score measures documentation age vs code activity via git history
target_value: Stale/abandoned classification with ratio
notes: Stale docs are worse than no docs

requirement_text: Navigability score measures file reads needed to answer canonical questions
target_value: Mean reads per question across probe sessions
notes: Dynamic cost measurement via agent probes

requirement_text: Duplication score detects redundant intent across files via text similarity
target_value: Jaccard shingling with 0.6 threshold on paragraph pairs
notes: Mechanism by which scatter becomes actively harmful

requirement_text: Composite entropy score normalizes and weights all dimensions into single metric
target_value: Float 0-10 with per-dimension breakdown
notes: Enables cross-project comparison and correlation analysis

target_value: Agent builds complete app with tests from zero
notes: Hardest case for RTMX -- no exploration tax in control

requirement_text: Brownfield experiment tests navigation overhead on unfamiliar codebase
target_value: Agent completes 3 tasks of varying complexity
notes: Tests exploration overhead and amortization across tasks

requirement_text: Self-referential experiment replays RTMX development with ground truth comparison
target_value: Historical token cost vs experimental conditions
notes: Only experiment with ground truth treatment data

notes: Single source of truth for all analysis

notes: Prevents orphan HTTP servers from cascading failures

notes: Prevents false FAILs from slow dependency installation

requirement_text: Inter-run isolation with port pre-flight checks and orphan cleanup

notes: Ensures each run starts with clean environment

target_value: Re-analysis on unchanged inputs produces no computation
notes: Prevents wasted computation at scale
